_about: Where the sources disagree about Harmony (HM). Nothing here is settled until checked in person on board. The one exception is 'likely': the data follows the other sources because the schedule, post-refit reports and Royal's app all agree against a stale plan label; those entries leave the Map check card, and anything seen on board still overrides them. The map data keeps the 'using' value until then; never overwrite it silently from a new scrape. Every new scrape (a new SVG profile, more Royal app screenshots) is compared with the data and each difference is added here. After the sailing, the owner's on-board log settles each entry: set 'status' to 'confirmed' with 'truth', then fix the data (overrides, venue table) and rebuild. See tools/shipmap/README.md, Conflicts.

sources.svg: Royal's deck-plan SVGs, profile 2396 (sailings from May 21, 2026): the initial scrape, what the map data is built from
sources.app: Screenshots of the deck plans in Royal's Android app, 2026-09-26 (decks 2, 5, 6, 8, 14, 15) and 2026-09-29 (decks 2-6, 8, 9, 14-17); schematic, positions about 5 m out, up to ~15 m on decks 6 and 14
sources.schedule: Royal's products listing (venue codes and titles): the 2026-10-01 sailing, pulled 2026-09-27 with cruise_sync.py --dump-products, and the Oct 1, 3, 8 and 13 sailings, pulled 2026-09-29 (about 2,000 products); the venue table's codes come from them
sources.reports: Post-refit reports on Harmony's 2026 Royal Amplification (back in service May 21, 2026): Royal Caribbean Blog (2026-05-22, 2026-05-28), Cruise Critic (2026-05-24), charitybradley.com (2026-08-02)
